policy: A SampleWiki row receives an audited theorem card only after the primary theorem/corollary and its proof route have been checked. Missing proof text is recorded as omitted/inherited, never reconstructed as if it appeared in the source.

formalization_phases.title: Common Chewi Chapter 1 interfaces
items: Finish the Chapter 1.1 Ito/SDE/Markov-process route already owned by the existing Chapter 1 branches.
Reuse the Chapter 1.2-1.3 semigroup, carre-du-champ, transport, and Wasserstein roots from the existing foundation lane.
Add a regularity-aware relative-Fisher interface and KL/Fisher dissipation.
Close Chewi Theorem 1.4.5 and its Fisher-Wasserstein first-order consequence.

formalization_phases.title: Proximal-sampler analytic spine
items: Chewi Theorem 8.3.1 simultaneous f-divergence flow.
Forward/backward heat-flow specializations and W2 contraction/time reversal.
Chewi Theorem 8.4.1 ideal proximal sampler under log-concavity.
Chewi Theorems 8.5.1/8.5.2 and Corollary 8.6.3.

formalization_phases.title: Classical LMC / ULD / MALA roots
items: Chewi 7.3.5 and 7.6.5.

formalization_phases.title: Frontier proximal/FORS implementation
items: Chen-Chewi-Daskalakis-Rakhlin Theorem G.1, with inherited RGO-error tracking made explicit.

formalization_phases.title: Exact ULD / FORS
formalization_phases.status: blocked by A/C plus path-law interfaces
items: Girsanov path density and FORS estimator.
Single-step Renyi error and error composition.
Chen-Chewi-Rakhlin-Zhang Theorem 3.2.

formalization_phases.title: Non-log-concave Fisher frontier
items: Chewi Theorem 11.2.1 and Fisher convexity/averaging.
High-accuracy RGO reduction (Theorem 6.1 in the FORS paper).
Chen-Chewi-Rakhlin-Zhang Theorem 6.2.
Chewi 11.4.3/11.4.4 lower bounds after an oracle-complexity interface exists.

formalization_phases.title: Stochastic and finite-sum oracle results
items: Formalize the stochastic-gradient/finite-sum oracle model first.
Then Chewi 10.1.2/10.1.3 and the COLT 2026 upper/lower bounds.

formalization_phases.title: Weak-smooth and mirror geometry
items: Formalize Bregman/mirror geometry and reuse the Chapter 1 Ito formula.
Then Chewi 10.3.28 and the weak-smooth frontier cases.

formalization_phases.title: Convex-body membership-oracle branch
items: Build convex-body and membership-query interfaces.
Then Kook-Zhang and Kook-Vempala warm-start/annealing results.
